phase.name: Project Management and Versioning
phase.goal: Introduce project-based organization for assets and exhibitions, along with explicit versioning and manual commit points.

in.item: ExhibitionVersion records with parent_version_id, comment, created_at, created_by
"Save as new version" button in planner
Loading a selected version for editing

backend.item: Implement Project entity/schema to group Assets and ExhibitionVersions.
Update Asset and Exhibition/Instance tables to include projectId foreign key.
Implement endpoints for Project CRUD operations: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /projects.
Update GET /assets and GET /instances to accept projectId query param for filtering.
Implement POST /exhibitions/:id/versions to create a new version from current state (instances, movable walls).
Add GET endpoints to list versions and fetch specific versions for an exhibition.

frontend.item: Add Project Selector to global header: Dropdown with search text field to filter/select active project.
Update Asset Manager to fetch and display only assets associated with the selected project.
Update 3D Viewer to load only placements/instances associated with the selected project.
Add a "Save as new version" button in planner, opening a dialog for a commit comment.
On commit, send current state to backend to create a new ExhibitionVersion linked to the active project.
Add a versions panel listing all versions with timestamps and comments; allow selecting which version to load.

successCriteria.item: A curator can create multiple projects and switch between them via the header.
Switching projects clears the current view and loads the correct assets and 3D placements for that project.
A curator can create multiple versions with distinct comments and switch between them within a project.
Each version loads its own snapshot of artwork instances and room state.
